reviews.review_text: The book was very fun to read. It awakened feelings that are hard to describe. I had some issues with the payment, but it was quickly solved by a good customer care agent.
The author has done such a great job expressing herself
Enjoyed it quite a well but something is missing. Also, the delivery was kinda late. Yet, I still enjoyed waiting for it
My kid ordered it without me noticing it. I thought I had to pay for it. But the customer support was nice and they gave me my money back and I got keep the book. The kiddo is happy
Horrible mixer. The build quality was so bad that I had to return it asap. The return policy is even worse. They did their best to not give me a refund.
I think I made a mistake buying this mixer. While it does its job, the power isn't enough
Does for what the price is. Plastic quality, poor power, but from price perspective you can't expect much.
Besides fast delivery, there isn't much to say here. The quality is bad, the customer support is bad, only shipping is good.
Had a blast listening on this tape recorder. Good old days
Delivery got delayed due to unkown reason. But when it arrived, I had a blast. Finally able to listen to my old tapes. Memory lanes
While advertised as a 70's tape recorder, it doesn't have a headphone jack. You can connect to bluetooth but that just doesn't give that 70s vibe
I feel like the quality could have been better. It feels like a cheap plastic. But it could be me. Besides that the delivery was great. Right on the time.
